title: Cap Chaos level — format v3
description: One level, fully data-driven (GDD §6). Written for designers and their own tools: every colour is a NUMBER (see $defs.colorId), every flag is a named field. Structural checks live here; semantic checks (colour balance, solvability, link targets, merge points and pick zone) are LevelValidator V4–V8. Format v1/v2 files describe a bottle stack and no longer load: regenerate them.

id.description: Must equal the file name without extension.

extraSlots.description: Locked slots right of the open ones (R20): each opens for coins or a rewarded ad, for this round only. slots + extraSlots ≤ 6.

colors.description: Palette subset used by this level. Hex values live in DesignTokens, never here.

loop.description: The oval conveyor (R1–R4). Track position 0 is the first row of the pick zone (the front straight, in front of the slots); positions grow in the direction of travel. The view derives the oval's shape from rows and pickRows: two straights of pickRows rows, the rest is the two bends.

rows.description: Rows of belt round the oval.

pickRows.description: Rows of the pick zone, track positions 0..pickRows-1. V8: rows ≥ 2 × pickRows + 6.

feeders.description: Queues of bottles that join the oval (R4), a whole queue row at a time: the front row steps on only when the belt row passing the merge point is empty on every track it needs.

mergeAt.description: Track position the feeder joins at. V8: outside the pick zone, one feeder per position.

bottles.description: The queue, front first, row by row: bottle i waits in queue row i / width on track i % width. The generator paints every queue row one colour.

initial.description: Optional: the belt at the start, one array of `width` cellIds per row (row r starts at track position r). Absent = the belt starts empty; every bottle waits in a feeder and joins while the belt runs.

lanes.description: Conveyor queues left→right. Element [0] of each lane is the tappable front tray.

links.description: Linked tray pairs (R19): they fly to the slots together (2 free slots needed); belts carrying a pair across two lanes only move together. V7: two neighbours in one lane, or the same position of two neighbouring lanes; a tray is in at most one link and is never locked.

loopShape.description: How the belt loop is drawn (presentation only; the rules never read it). A preset, or a rounded convex polygon: corners [x, z] clockwise seen from above, corner 0 → 1 the front edge (level, lowest, right → left, in front of the slots), each rounded by its radius (V9). Absent = oval.

solution.description: One winning tap sequence (lane indices). Written by Tools/LevelTool; V6 replays it as the solvability proof.

colorId.description: Game.Domain.CapColor: 1 Red (pink-red) · 2 Orange · 3 Blue · 4 Green · 5 Purple · 6 Yellow · 7 Cyan · 8 Brown. Never renumbered.

cellId.description: 0 = empty belt spot, otherwise a colorId.

hidden.description: Hidden tray (R17): tray and caps show '?' until the tray reaches the front of its lane.

lockTurns.description: Locked tray (R18): opens after this many trays fly to the slots while it stands at the front.
